name: OrderBell
author: Tomas / tbraxa
description: Privacy-first, read-only Shopify order alerts in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Read-only order notifications and recent order status for Shopify stores.

schema.label: Stores
schema.description: Comma-separated canonical myshopify.com domains, for example northwind.myshopify.com. Schemes, paths, ports, and custom storefront domains are rejected.

schema.label: Check every
schema.description: Seconds between read-only checks. OrderBell clamps the interval to 60–3600 seconds.

schema.label: Hide order details
schema.description: Hides the order name/number and amount in the panel and per-order notifications. Store and statuses remain visible; burst notifications always show only store and count. Recommended on shared or visible screens.

schema.label: Include test orders
schema.description: Include Shopify test orders in the panel, unread count, and notifications. Turning this off clears retained test rows and queued test alerts on the next poll. Keep this off for normal use.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Request a 30-second lifetime for Omarchy alerts after the initial baseline. Up to five new orders per poll are delivered individually; larger bursts use a count-only summary.
